# Stack'd

> Stack'd turns phone-free time into a shared game: stack your phones with friends, hold the silence together, and earn back the hours.

Stack'd is a real-time focus app. Friends open a shared room, stack their
phones, and the room watches every tilt, lift, and screen wake together.
Completed sessions earn XP, streaks, achievements, and seasonal rank.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Stack'd is, how shared focus rooms work, and how to join one with a room code.
- [Philosophy](/philosophy): The manifesto behind Stack'd — kinetic verdict, atomic sync, and earned time.
- [Component Catalog](/catalog): Live inventory of the UI primitives and motion effects used across Stack'd.
- [SDK](/sdk): Zero-dependency TypeScript client for the Stack'd webhook and public API surface.
